title: A Correction Note on Two Early Intelligence Bound Sources: The Unrestricted Axiom Is False, and "No Finite Compensation" Proves Finite Compensation
abstract: Two early Viridis Lean sources of January 2026 contain formal text that does not match its prose. First, the axiom intelligence_bound states dI/dt <= P/(kB T ln 2) * D for every real dI/dt under elementary guards, and is false as written: the instance dI/dt = 1, P = D = 0, kB = T = 1 reduces it to 1 <= 0. Second, a theorem named no_finite_compensation, introduced as saying that no finite power increase can compensate a loss of the diversity factor D, in fact proves that the finite increase P*dD/(D-dD) restores the bound exactly. We give Lean 4 proofs of two sealed statements. P5.UnrestrictedBoundFalse shows that the unrestricted axiom is false. P5.CompensationUnderCeiling separates four facts about the capacity cap(P,D,C) = P*D/C that the historical prose runs together: (1) after a partial loss 0 < dD < D the power P*D/(D-dD) restores the capacity and is the only power that does; (2) under a power ceiling P <= Pmax, restoration is possible exactly when dD <= D*(1-P/Pmax); (3) the compensating power grows without bound as dD -> D from below; and (4) at D = 0 no power restores a positive capacity. In economic terms, along a level set of P*D the two inputs substitute for each other. D is essential, since nothing replaces it at zero, but it is not non-substitutable in the interior; what makes a loss of D uncompensable is a finite power ceiling. Both results are elementary corrections of formal text. They say nothing about how any agent behaves, about any measured value of D, or about ecology.

claims.text: For cap P D C = P*D/C with C>0 and P>0: (1) if 0<dD<D, the power P*D/(D-dD) restores cap P D C at diversity D-dD and is the only power that does; (2) if moreover P<=Pmax, some P'<=Pmax restores it iff dD <= D*(1-P/Pmax); (3) if D>0, for every M there is delta>0 with P*D/(D-dD) > M whenever D-delta<dD<D; (4) if D>0, every power P' gives cap P' 0 C = 0 < cap P D C.

It is not the case that for all reals dIdt, P, D, kB, T with kB>0, T>0, P>=0, 0<=D<=1 one has dIdt <= P/(kB*T*log 2) * D (counterinstance dIdt=1, P=D=0, kB=T=1). Proof carried forward unchanged from P5-T002.

next_steps: Both sealed P5 statements now have candidate proofs that pass viridis-lean-check (preview). Next: (a) if the historical files can be made available, check mechanically the claim that no declaration depends on intelligence_bound (#print axioms on each declaration); (b) optionally propose a statement for a well-posed successor bound with the rate tied to a modelled system; (c) optionally generalise the compensation facts to cap = f(P)*D for increasing unbounded f, or to Cobb-Douglas P^a D^b, to show which conclusions depend on the unit-exponent form. Otherwise P5 can be closed.
